text: {"fixed_clause": "To ensure tailored commercial engagement and comprehensive service delivery, non-sensitive categories may be processed under our broader operational interests and made accessible across all internal business units for cross-departmental campaign optimization, while sensitive categories including health metrics, religious affiliations, and biometric indicators are excluded from legitimate interest processing and marketing use, with health data access strictly limited to those who need it."}

data.fixed_clause: To ensure tailored commercial engagement and comprehensive service delivery, non-sensitive categories may be processed under our broader operational interests and made accessible across all internal business units for cross-departmental campaign optimization, while sensitive categories including health metrics, religious affiliations, and biometric indicators are excluded from legitimate interest processing and marketing use, with health data access strictly limited to those who need it.
